decisions.themeSymmetry: Union of visible expanded menu entries; missing entries use counterpart geometry and existing MenuButton/Badge theme tokens. All raw layouts are retained.
decisions.brand: Original frame SVG paths preserve PF BeauSans Pro typography without a substitute font.
decisions.selectedState: Sidebar treats Figma active menu item as current navigation; browser hover/press remain native.
decisions.checks: Do not run checks until user permits them.
